m1_length.description: Channel Length of the lower cascode vptat generator transistor

m1_width.description: Channel Width of the lower cascode vptat generator transistor

m2_length.description: Channel Length of the upper cascode vptat generator transistor

m2_width.description: Channel Width of the upper cascode vptat generator transistor

pbias_length.description: Channel Length of the PMOS bias transistors

m3_width.description: Channel Width of the bias transistor on the vptat generator branch

m6m7_length.description: Channel Length of the M6/M7 nmos current mirror pair in the self-biased voltage following current mirror (sbvfcm)

m6m7_width_base.description: Shared unit-cell channel width for the M6/M7 nmos current-mirror pair (sbvfcm) -- actual per-leg width is this * the leg's own integer factor (m6_factor/m7_factor), computed in Python before schematic substitution (never a formula in the netlist). See this file's derived_parameters.width_groups.

m6_factor.description: Integer multiple of m6m7_width_base giving M6's actual channel width (diode-connected mirror leg) -- also the intended unit-cell count for future common-centroid layout.

m7_factor.description: Integer multiple of m6m7_width_base giving M7's actual channel width (mirrored leg) -- together with m6_factor this sets the sbvfcm's current-mirror ratio, a real circuit design freedom, not just a matching artifact.

m8m9_length.description: Channel Length of the M8/M9 nmos cascode pair stacked above M6/M7 in the sbvfcm

m8m9_width_base.description: Shared unit-cell channel width for the M8/M9 nmos cascode pair stacked above M6/M7 -- actual per-leg width is this * the leg's own integer factor (m8_factor/m9_factor). See this file's derived_parameters.width_groups.

m8_factor.description: Integer multiple of m8m9_width_base giving M8's actual channel width. Locked to 1 for now (min=max=1) -- preserves today's exact M8=M9 invariant; widen only as a deliberate later decision once a reason to ratio the cascodes differently is identified.

m9_factor.description: Integer multiple of m8m9_width_base giving M9's actual channel width. Locked to 1 for now, see m8_factor.

m10_width.description: Channel Width of transistor M10 (pmos current mirror transistor biasing the sbvfcm)

m11_width.description: Channel Width of transistor M11 (pmos current mirror transistor biasing the sbvfcm)

m12_length.description: Channel Length of transistor M12 (startup circuit transistor)

m12_width.description: Channel Width of transistor M12 (startup circuit transistor)

m13_length.description: Channel Length of transistor M13 (startup circuit transistor)

m13_width.description: Channel Width of transistor M13 (startup circuit transistor)

startup_cap_side.description: Side length of the square MiM startup capacitor C1 (w=l=side). Halved from the default topology's 7u as a starting point for the lvfet variant, since the 1.2V M1/M2 devices are expected to cause startup voltage overshoot that will need further tuning.

startup_cap_mult.description: Instance multiplier (m=) of the startup capacitor C1. Reduced from the default topology's 10 to 1 as a starting point for the lvfet variant, since the 1.2V M1/M2 devices are expected to cause startup voltage overshoot that will need further tuning.

width_groups.description: M6/M7 nmos current-mirror pair -- shares symmetry.islands' id on purpose so a future layout-generation pass can cross-reference this group's unit width/factors with that island's mirrored placement by the same key.
M8/M9 nmos cascode pair stacked above M6/M7. No symmetry.islands entry exists yet for this pair -- this id is a reservation for when one is added.

islands._comment: Self-biased voltage-following current mirror pair (m6_width/m7_width, shared m6m7_length) -- the real validation target for Fase 1 placement.

node_priority._status: reservado para a Fase 2 (roteamento A*) -- schema ainda não implementado, só reservado aqui pra não precisar de outra migração depois
